summary.zh-TW: 往下捲時區塊固定在畫面上，裡面的面板改成往左移動；走完後恢復一般的直向捲動。每個面板進入畫面時，文字會跟著升起。
summary.en: Scrolling down pins the section and moves its panels to the left; once they’re done, normal vertical scrolling resumes. Each panel’s text rises as it comes into view.

text.zh-TW: 軌道往左移「軌道總寬 − 畫面寬」，剛好讓最後一個面板停在畫面右邊。寫成函式，搭配 invalidateOnRefresh，視窗大小改變時會重新計算。
text.en: Moves the track left by its total width minus the screen width, so the last panel stops at the right edge. As a function with invalidateOnRefresh, it recalculates on resize.

text.zh-TW: 橫向捲動一定要等速，捲多少就移多少。用 expo 之類的 ease，會覺得捲動和畫面對不上。
text.en: Horizontal scrolling must be linear — move exactly as much as you scroll. An ease like expo makes scroll and motion feel out of sync.

text.zh-TW: 在 start 到 end 之間把區塊固定在畫面上，ScrollTrigger 會自動在下方補上等長的空白，讓頁面有東西可以捲。
text.en: Pins the section between start and end, and ScrollTrigger adds matching space below so the page has room to scroll.

text.zh-TW: 要往下捲多遠才走完。SPEED 改成 2，就要捲兩倍遠，橫向移動感覺比較慢、比較穩。
text.en: How far you need to scroll to finish. Set SPEED to 2 and it takes twice the scroll, so the sideways motion feels slower and steadier.

text.zh-TW: 面板是橫向移進畫面的，一般的 ScrollTrigger 看不到。用 containerAnimation 告訴它「看 move 這段動畫的進度」，start／end 也改用 left、right。
text.en: Panels enter sideways, which a normal ScrollTrigger can’t see. containerAnimation tells it to follow the progress of the move animation; start/end use left and right instead.
